findings.title: Use current activation callback after asynchronous workflow reads
findings.why_it_matters: New edits or a newly uploaded source can be discarded without confirmation when a workflow import or saved-workflow read finishes late. Start from a clean saved workflow awaiting a source, begin a delayed JSON import, then change the workflow name or finish uploading a source before the JSON read resolves: the captured activate callback still sees the original unsaved=false and absent view, so it skips the replacement confirmation and clears the newer session. The generation and disabled checks do not catch edits or a source upload that has already finished; invoking the current callback makes the confirmation inspect current state.
findings.validation_reason: The origin/main diff introduces captured props.activate calls at src/ui/SavedWorkflows.tsx:100/111; when an async Open/Import begins from a clean saved workflow and a name edit or source upload completes before its read resolves, unchanged activation/selection tokens and the now-false disabled guard allow the old Workspace.tsx:145/158–163 closure to bypass confirmation and clear the newer draft/source through Session.end(), and reachability is demonstrated on the reviewed 93ed147 plus staged tree by docs/reviews/u4/activation-race-red.json using Playwright 1.64.0, Node 24.21.0, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, local preview with service workers blocked, and a synthetic deferred File.text import released after source upload/preview/export, where workflow-portability.spec.ts:183 expected one confirmation and observed zero after 5000 ms (subsequent preservation assertions were not reached).
